title: Draft: canonical model-call result and transcript entry
description: What the agent runner reports in CompleteStep.output_json (or as a blob claim-check above 256 KiB) for a sagat.ai.model task, and the body of an ASSISTANT transcript entry. Adapters map every provider wire format to this form; the server validates it, checks tool names and inputs against the pinned declaration, scans it for the attempt's resolved secret values and only then commits it. Draft for feature 025; T025-002 publishes it as specs/001-platform-foundation/contracts/model-turn.schema.json.

providerRequestId.description: Provider correlation id (for example the request-id header); kept on spans and the turn row, never on metrics.

input.description: Bounded JSON value; validated against the tool's inputSchema by the server, never by the runner alone.

bytesBase64.description: Exact provider block bytes, replayed unchanged to the same provider kind within the same agent step; never interpreted, streamed or shown outside the transcript endpoint.

known.description: False when the provider did not report usage; the reservation is then kept.

toolResults.description: Body of a TOOL_RESULTS transcript entry, built by the server when the turn's last tool call settles; results are in request order.

reason.description: Fixed, safe reason sent to the model; never a provider or executor message.

content.description: Projected tool output (bounded JSON) or a fixed reason text.
